Name: FlyingSwordRing
Author: Liangpite
Description:
⚠️重要提醒：模组暂未经过联机测试，大概率不支持多人联机。
飞剑可以自动索敌攻击，解放手动挥舞武器，可以让你专注挖矿！

当你切换到镐子的时候，飞剑会优先攻击怪物，然后顺便帮你挖矿。

当你切换到斧头的时候，飞剑会寻找离你最近的树木进行砍树，砍树伤害取决于斧头品质与等级。每次砍树消耗 2 点体力，每 1 级战斗等级减少 0.1 体力消耗，战斗等级满级后砍树仅消耗 1 点体力。

当你切换到水壶的时候，飞剑会自动为开垦的土地浇水，消耗水壶水量。

当你切换到镰刀的时候，飞剑进入镰刀模式，自动收割成熟作物（0.5% 概率收获价值不菲的醉仙果）、果树、苔藓、可收获机器与野外采集品；还会自动翻垃圾桶，NPC 目睹后会感到惊讶并提升好感度。采集品品质由武器等级与战斗等级共同决定。挥动镰刀时，飞剑切换至杂物清除模式，自动清理杂草、纤维以及枯萎作物。
当你切换到挤奶桶，飞剑自动搜寻范围内可产奶的动物，自动挤奶并抚摸动物与宠物。

当你切换到剪刀，飞剑自动寻找可以剪毛的动物，自动完成剪毛。

手持肥料时，飞剑将肥料自动播撒至开垦土地（左键启动）。

手持种子时，飞剑自动将种子播种到开垦土地（左键启动）。
手持鱼竿时，飞剑自动垂钓。渔获品质可配置，默认依据武器等级判定：武器等级 1 拥有 1% 铱星、2% 金星、4% 银星概率，剩余为普通品质。还有 0.05% 概率钓出隐秘暗黑宝箱，宝箱内物品等待你来探索！
按下 R 键，御剑传送至农舍门口；再次按下 T 键，返回传送前位置。初始消耗 20 体力，每级战斗等级减少 2 点消耗，满级无体力消耗。

如果当天是已结识 NPC 的生日，按下 G 键直接传送到该 NPC 身旁；完成村民委托后，按下 Y 键快速前往委托人身边。
集齐五把飞剑且玩家保持静止一段时间，飞剑会躁动并触发专属动作；飞剑悬浮状态新增帅气待机动画。
飞剑各项功能依靠[b]尘缘（Karmic Bonds）[/b]逐步解锁，配置中也可选择开局解锁全部功能。

初始解锁：攻击模式 & 挖矿子模式。
[quote]补充机制：武器带有虫杀手词条才会主动攻击甲虫；拥有十字军词条才能攻击木乃伊，否则飞剑不会针对上述怪物。持有剑意效果时，可以透视矿洞内的楼梯。[/quote][list]
[*]30 尘缘：解锁伐木功能[/*]
[*]60 尘缘：解锁浇水功能[/*]
[*]100 尘缘：永久速度 + 1 Buff；之后每获得 150 尘缘速度再 + 1，最高 + 3[/*]
[*]120 尘缘：解锁播种功能（支持慢速 / 快速播种，播种开关快捷键可在模组配置调整）[/*]
[*]180 尘缘：解锁飞剑垂钓；0.05% 概率捕获深海隐秘暗黑宝箱，宝箱内藏有惊人奖励！[/*]
[*]220 尘缘：解锁镰刀功能；收割机器时可自动填充上次使用的原料。每 1 级战斗等级提供额外收获经验加成[/*]
[*]258 尘缘：解锁升星效果！飞剑收获物品拥有 0.5% 概率转化为铱星品质；后续每获取 100 尘缘概率提升 0.5%，上限 3%[/*]
[*]300 尘缘：解锁挤奶、剪毛、抚摸动物功能[/*]
[*]350 尘缘：解锁御剑回城；G 键可传送至当日生日的相识 NPC 身边[/*]
[*]410 尘缘：双倍收获！飞剑收获物品 6% 概率产出双倍；每 100 尘缘提升 3% 概率，最高 15%；累计 830 尘缘解锁三倍收获！[/*]
[*]520 尘缘：物品吸附功能（需要在设置手动开启，存在潜在 BUG，仅非农业模式生效）[/*]
[*]900 尘缘：轮回转世！每日一次，承受致命伤害时触发复活，并且获得短暂无敌时间。[/*]
[/list]集齐五把飞剑，解锁专属帅气待机动画！

按下 N 键，飞剑飞向远处，临时停用全部飞剑功能。
解锁全部尘缘能力，且战斗等级≥9 后，山谷中会生成灵气。击杀怪物、收割作物 / 采集野外物品时，1% 概率生成灵气。吸收灵气即可踏入炼气期。各个境界的专属技能请到戒指内自行探索！内容深度较高，肝度十足，暂不剧透！

修仙系统将在下个版本（2.4.0）更新。


⚠️ Important Notice: Multiplayer has not been tested. This mod is most likely not compatible with multiplayer sessions.
The flying swords automatically lock onto enemies and attack, freeing your hands so you can focus on mining!

When you switch to the Pickaxe, flying swords prioritize attacking monsters and then help you mine.

When you switch to the Axe, flying swords target the nearest tree. Damage depends on your axe tier and quality. Each tree cut costs 2 Energy. Every Combat Level reduces energy consumption by 0.1, capped at 1 Energy per tree cut at max Combat Level.

When you switch to the Watering Can, flying swords automatically water tilled soil, consuming water from your can.

When you switch to the Scythe, flying swords activate Harvest Mode. They automatically gather ripe crops (0.5% chance to obtain Immortal Fruit of great value), fruit trees, moss, harvestable machines and forage items. The swords also rummage through trash cans; nearby NPCs will be surprised and gain friendship. Forage quality scales with weapon tier and Combat Level. Swing your scythe to toggle Debris Clear Mode, where swords remove weeds, fiber and dead crops automatically.
When you switch to the Milk Pail, flying swords locate nearby milk-producing animals and automatically milk them, alongside petting animals and pets.

When you switch to Shears, flying swords search for shearable animals and harvest wool automatically.
While holding Fertilizer, flying swords spread fertilizer onto tilled soil (activate with Left Click).

While holding Seeds, flying swords plant seeds onto tilled soil (activate with Left Click).
While holding the Fishing Rod, flying swords fish automatically. Catch quality is configurable. By default, your weapon tier determines odds: Tier 1 weapon grants 1% Iridium, 2% Gold, 4% Silver quality, with remaining catches regular quality. There is also a 0.05% chance to fish up a hidden Dark Treasure Chest. What secrets lie inside?
Press R to teleport back to your Farmhouse doorway. Press T again to return to your previous location before teleporting. Initial cost: 20 Energy. Each Combat Level reduces cost by 2 Energy, zero energy cost at max level.

If it is the birthday of an NPC you have met, press G to teleport straight to them. After accepting a villager’s quest, press Y to teleport to that villager.
When you wield 5 flying swords and stay still for a period, the swords grow restless and trigger special animations. A polished idle animation is added for floating sword mode.
Flying sword abilities unlock gradually by accumulating [b]Karmic Bonds[/b]. You may also enable an option to unlock all abilities from the start in mod config.

Base Unlocks: Combat Mode & Mining Submode.
[quote]Extra Mechanics: Swords only target bugs if your weapon has Bug Killer; they only attack mummies if your weapon has Crusader. Without these enchantments, those enemies will be ignored. With Sword Intent, you can see ladders inside the mines through walls.[/quote][list]
[*]30 Karmic Bonds: Unlock Lumberjack Mode[/*]
[*]60 Karmic Bonds: Unlock Watering Mode[/*]
[*]100 Karmic Bonds: Permanent +1 Speed Buff. Gain another +1 Speed every additional 150 Karmic Bonds, maximum +3[/*]
[*]120 Karmic Bonds: Unlock Seeding Mode (Slow/Fast seeding available; toggle hotkey configurable)[/*]
[*]180 Karmic Bonds: Unlock Auto Fishing. 0.05% chance to catch the hidden Deep Sea Dark Treasure Chest with astonishing rewards![/*]
[*]220 Karmic Bonds: Unlock Scythe Harvest Mode. Automatically refill machines with the last used materials upon harvest. Every Combat Level grants extra XP bonus from harvesting[/*]
[*]258 Karmic Bonds: Star Upgrade Effect. Items harvested by flying swords have a 0.5% chance to turn Iridium-quality. The chance rises by 0.5% per extra 100 Karmic Bonds, capped at 3%[/*]
[*]300 Karmic Bonds: Unlock Milking, Shearing & Animal Petting[/*]
[*]350 Karmic Bonds: Unlock Farmhouse Recall. Press G to teleport to NPCs celebrating their birthday[/*]
[*]410 Karmic Bonds: Double Harvest. 6% chance for double items from harvest. Gain +3% chance per extra 100 Karmic Bonds, capped at 15%. Reach 830 total Karmic Bonds to unlock Triple Harvest![/*]
[*]520 Karmic Bonds: Item Magnet (Must be manually enabled in config. Potential bugs. Only works outside farming modes.)[/*]
[*]900 Karmic Bonds: Samsara Rebirth. Once per day, revive upon taking fatal damage with brief invincibility.[/*]
[/list]Collect all 5 flying swords to unlock exclusive elegant idle animations!

Press N to recall the swords away temporarily and disable all flying sword functions.
After unlocking all Karmic Bond abilities and reaching Combat Level 9 or higher, Spirit Qi will spawn across the valley. You have a 1% chance to generate Spirit Qi when defeating monsters or harvesting crops/forage. Absorb Spirit Qi to advance to the Qi Refining Realm.

Discover all unique realm skills inside the ring yourself! Progression requires heavy grinding, and details remain unspoiled.

The Cultivation System will arrive in the next version (2.4.0).
